mapper.sql: s.id, s.token, s.market_id, q.public_no, s.user_id, s.kind, s.option_id, s.show_amount, s.amount, s.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM market_share s JOIN market_question q ON q.id = s.market_id WHERE s.token = #{token}

SELECT FROM market_share s JOIN market_question q ON q.id = s.market_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.market_id = #{marketId} AND s.kind = #{kind} AND s.option_id = #{optionId} AND s.show_amount = #{showAmount}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO market_share (token, market_id, user_id, kind, option_id, show_amount, amount, created_at) VALUES (#{token}, #{marketId}, #{userId}, #{kind}, #{optionId}, #{showAmount}, #{amount}, #{now})
